title: Prohibitions enforce connector-delimited object phrases (VI fix); scheduler retry budget scoped to policy generation
description: Production failure: term-only prohibition enforcement OR-matched every extracted token, so Vietnamese bans (e.g. 'không được hứa lợi nhuận hoặc tư vấn tài chính' -> hứa/lợi/nhuận/vấn/tài/chính) poisoned every plan via common words (tài liệu, vấn đề, quá trình), exhausting planner retries and wedging the objective in BLOCKED_RETRY_EXHAUSTED. Fix A: GoalRequirement gains `phrases` — object groups split on OBJECT_LIST_JOINERS (và/hoặc/and/or plus hay/với/cùng/cũng/kèm/như/nor/with/plus/along — independent audit caught that narrower splitting merged banned objects into unmatchable mega-phrases, failing open); plan-coverage enforces phrase-granular matching (phraseMatchSpans with bounded function-word gaps) in both the action-gated and term-only branches, with bounded NEGATION_WINDOW suppression extended to term-only and exemption words miễn/ngoài removed from the marker set (they suppress real acts: 'miễn phí tư vấn tài chính' is still consulting). `terms` minting, the TELEGRAM capability gate, and all scope/segment semantics are unchanged. Fix B: the scheduler retry budget is scoped to the policy generation — accountWake/observe reset retry_count only when binding a NEW policy_version, so the existing owner disable→configure→enable recovery restarts the budget; unchanged bindings never reset it (B09/C16/R4 semantics preserved). No new actions, routes, or schema migrations (the additive `phrases` field lands in contractDigest deterministically). Deterministic, append-only, no model calls.
